name: Nai Yang Beach Resort & Spa
detail: It was close to the airport, near the sea, and the pool was nice. The room was upgraded and spacious. However, the walls were thin, and there was a door that seemed like a connecting room, so I could hear coughing at night. There was also a balcony, and many people were sitting there. There are four pools, including one for children, so families with kids might enjoy it as well. There was a massage service on the property, so I went there at night. The only inconvenience was the lack of a bus; I think a grab or a car is necessary.

name: Ibis Phuket Patong
detail: Staying as a group, the service staff were great. They took care of the breakfast arrangements on time, which was excellent. Some hotels don't prepare it in time, causing delays for our boat tour.

name: Wyndham Grand Nai Harn Beach Phuket
detail: We had a great time staying here! The staff were super friendly and always had a smile, especially the restaurant team. We were traveling with a young child, and the staff at the Kids' Club were really helpful and took great care of our little one. Also, huge thanks to the housekeeping team. At first, we told them not to clean because we felt bad about how messy our room was with all our kid's stuff. But when we came back in the evening, they had made everything completely clean and organized. If you're looking for a quiet, relaxing family trip near Nai Harn Beach, definitely stay here.
area: Nai Harn Beach,Phuket - View on map

name: Saba Suites Hotel Patong Phuket
detail: It's nice that the central shopping area and Patong Beach are close. If you come considering that it gets noisy outside until dawn and the windows are thin, it will be a reasonable choice. The staff at Maple were kind and helpful. Thank you.

name: The Sixteenth Naiyang Beach Hotel - Free Schedule Airport Shuttle
detail: This is a place I reserved for an overnight stay near the airport. The family room was spacious enough. Although I didn't use the pool, there was one available, as well as a gym. There were many massage shops nearby, so I went to one to get a Thai massage, and I was also able to eat at a Michelin-rated restaurant. In the early morning, I was able to use the free shuttle to the airport. If I travel here again, I think I will stay at this hotel near the airport.

name: GP House Phuket
detail: The location is good, just right for both the beach and city walks. The hotel's facilities are a bit old, it's true, but the kindness of the staff exceeds that. They are very friendly and helpful; for instance, when I was swimming in the pool, they lent me goggles, which was very nice. They always greeted us with smiles and kindness, making my child very happy. The hotel pool is a well-maintained size for a hotel located in a busy area. Also, there is a small travel agency outside the hotel, and the women there are kind and offer reasonable prices. I booked an elephant ride and a ferry to Phi Phi Islands there, and although I checked elsewhere, this was the cheapest. It is very comforting to have a place that is kind to children when traveling with kids, so I feel glad to have stayed here.

name: Selina Serenity Rawai Phuket
detail: Located on a quiet beach with the sea right in front, the pool is beautifully stunning, and the resort atmosphere is overflowing, making it very pleasant. The staff is friendly and kind. The premises are clean everywhere, and cute cats greet you at every turn. The breakfast buffet is delicious, and I was satisfied. I stayed in a dormitory, but even in the dormitory, I could use all the facilities, and I had the best experience at an affordable price. If I come to Phuket again, I will definitely stay here again. I had a wonderful and comfortable stay.

name: Beach Comber
detail: The first time arriving at the hotel was quite scary, but once we actually checked in, everything was just fine. The staff were friendly and smiling. We brought our large suitcase, and since there was no elevator, the staff helped us carry our heavy bags (over 20 kilos) to our room and even helped choose a convenient room for us. The location is really great, with a small bar at the entrance where you can sit and drink. Just a short walk to the right, and you will find a 7-Eleven, McDonald's, and Swensen's, along with many other shops, with prices ranging from expensive to cheap. If you pay attention, you can find resting areas with tables costing 100 baht right in front of the beach. I think that's okay in the alley which doesn’t seem scary. We returned to our room after going out at 3 AM, and the whole alley was well-lit with soft music playing that wasn’t bothersome at all. This trip has been very good. (For anyone looking for a quiet, convenient place with delicious food to relax and heal the heart, yet near tourist attractions with plenty of people but still peaceful and not loud, with smiling staff) we feel that this place is just fine. Thank you for a good experience on our little trip.

name: Travelodge Phuket Town
detail: The room is clean, and the staff is very friendly and attentive. The location is great, with a 7-Eleven right across the street. It's very convenient to get around. I will definitely come back next time!

name: Lub d Phuket Patong
detail: It is a small, minimalist hotel with convenient travel options, allowing you to walk to the beach and various places. All the staff are lovely and provide great recommendations. Most of the guests are foreigners, about 99%. The hotel offers car rental services, making it convenient. The chosen room may be a bit small, but it has a view overlooking the pool. It is fully equipped with amenities, although there is no refrigerator. The bed is soft and very comfortable to sleep in. The hotel has a good vibe and many activities to do. I recommend staying here; it’s great!
